channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: How we could save petabytes of cache storage with Zstandard and Pingora
item.description: Could we get more cache space with the same hardware? We prototyped compression inside Cloudflare's cache to find out. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Presentation: Beyond Line Charts: Why Some Diversity in Telemetry Visualization Is Long Overdue
item.description: Yao Yue discusses the fundamental limitations of standard line charts for system observability. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: We are building an idiomatic RESTful API in Go 1.27
item.description: 100% Human Authored - Both Code/Doc In this series, We build a production-ready containerized RESTful API server application using following packages and tools. (1 source: rprogramming)

item.title: The pattern language of software architecture
item.description: Architectural Metapatterns is a compendium that organizes architectural patterns according to their structure and function into a universal pattern language. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: I need to keep some Slack connections alive. This should be easy.
item.description: Okay, but I have multiple replicas. And it gets slightly worse: the number of physical connections is not equal to the number of replicas, and it is not equal to the number of business-level connectors either. (1 source: rprogramming)

item.title: Presentation: Beyond Prompting: Context Engineering for Production-Grade AI
item.description: Ricardo Ferreira discusses moving beyond simple prompt engineering to build production-grade AI applications. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Introducing Adaptive Intelligence: Undermining the economics of every bot attack
item.description: Bot operators have historically had the economic advantage, bypassing static, deterministic detection rules with cheap proxies and retooling. (1 source: cloudflare)
